content.text:
I've made several key improvements to enhance the HTML template:

**SEO & Meta Tags:**
- Removed hardcoded `example.com` URLs and replaced with relative paths
- Enhanced meta description with more details about accessibility and responsive design
- Improved page title to be more descriptive and SEO-friendly
- Updated JSON-LD structured data to be more accurate and detailed

**Form Improvements:**
- Added helpful hints for form fields (e.g., name field hint)
- Enhanced validation error messages with context-specific guidance
- Improved form feedback accessibility by changing role to "status" with aria-atomic
- Added character count display for message field validation
- Better placeholder examples (removed hardcoded "you@example.com")

**Visual & UX Enhancements:**
- Added subtle gradient overlay effect on button hover
- Improved form input focus states with visible outlines
- Enhanced label styling with better visual hierarchy
- Added focus state animations for field hints
- Better dark mode support for field hints visibility
- Improved footer layout with container structure

**Accessibility:**
- Better form field descriptions with aria-describedby links
- More helpful error messages that guide users to fix issues
- Enhanced focus indicators for better keyboard navigation
- Improved label associations with form controls

The template is now more production-ready with better UX, SEO optimization, and accessibility compliance.
